name: simulate_darts_match
description: Simulate a professional darts match with a visit-level Monte Carlo engine and return win probabilities, fair odds, likely scorelines and expected total legs. Use this whenever the user asks who would win a darts match, for match odds, a scoreline, or an over/under on legs.

player_1_scoring_average.description: Player 1's three-dart scoring (First-9) average, typically 90-108. Defaults to 98 if unknown.

player_2_scoring_average.description: Player 2's three-dart scoring (First-9) average, typically 90-108. Defaults to 98 if unknown.

player_1_double_prob.description: Player 1's per-dart double (checkout) probability, 0-1, typically 0.35-0.45. Defaults to 0.40 if unknown.

player_2_double_prob.description: Player 2's per-dart double (checkout) probability, 0-1, typically 0.35-0.45. Defaults to 0.40 if unknown.

match_format.description: Match format. One of the presets: premier_league, players_championship, world_matchplay_r1, uk_open_final, world_championship_r1, world_championship_semi, world_championship_final; or a dynamic value like bestof11 or firstto6.

sims.description: Number of Monte Carlo simulations to run. Defaults to 10000. Higher is more precise but slower.
